audit_scope: F1720-F1726 Direct UEL-UMAT Coupling vs F1728-F1812 Recovery Donors

frozen_production_uel.formulation: Isotropic Degradation (g(d) multiplies all components of C_0)

amor_split_uel_v2.formulation: Amor et al. (2009) Volumetric-Deviatoric Split (Bulk modulus undegraded in compression)

item_2_step1_vs_step2_attribution_discre.discrepancy_explanation: Clerical misattribution in F1720 documentation. In reality, Step 2 of PK_F1720_COARSE_COUPLED.odb terminated at increment 356 with divergence; the donor extracted and used by execute_f1720_native_adaptive_remesh.py was explicitly stepName='Step-1' frame -1.

item_3_element_and_ip_mapping.architecture: 3-Layer Method A Overlay (Phase UEL, Mech UEL, Companion CPE4/CPE3 UMAT)

item_4_stress_freshness_and_cutbacks.call_order_invariant: Abaqus/Standard strictly evaluates elements in ascending label order; Layer 2 executes before Layer 3 within normal iterations.
item_4_stress_freshness_and_cutbacks.cutback_vulnerability: S_TENSOR_STORE stores trial stresses during every Newton iteration without separate committed/trial buffers. In rejected iterations or interrupted cutbacks, trial stresses persist in global COMMON memory.
item_4_stress_freshness_and_cutbacks.parallel_execution_hazard: Multi-threaded (SMP/MPI) access to shared COMMON memory without locks risks race conditions; serial execution was required.

item_5_mechanical_neutrality.single_element_patch: RF discrepancy = 0.0000% under dummy scaling s = 10^-11 / E_0 (Configuration B).
item_5_mechanical_neutrality.unscaled_stress_hazard: Unscaled Cauchy stress (s = 1.0) doubles internal force and inflates RF by +100.00% (Configuration C).
item_5_mechanical_neutrality.multi_element_structural_effect: In complex structures with kinematic couplings or pinned holes, companion dummy elements alter numerical conditioning and can cause MPC condensation artifacts if not carefully constrained.

item_6_constitutive_differences.frozen_production_uel: Isotropic degradation D_mech = g(d) C_0 for all strain states; crack driving energy psi_0^+ uses positive volumetric trace bracket but isotropic shear.
item_6_constitutive_differences.f1716_f1720_amor_uel: Amor et al. (2009) volumetric-deviatoric split; bulk modulus undegraded in compression (D_elas(1,1) = K_bulk + 4/3*mu*g(d)), crack driving energy psi_0^+ uses deviatoric quadratic form.
item_6_constitutive_differences.consequence: Blindly substituting F1720's Amor UEL into production decks alters the mechanical boundary value problem from isotropic degradation to Amor split, modifying peak load, compliance, and crack path.

item_7_forward_solver_failure_and_recove.forward_solver_outcome: Diverged in Step 2 at increment 127/356, t_2 = 0.2215 s, u_y = 0.005664 mm due to time increment collapse dt < 10^-9 s.
item_7_forward_solver_failure_and_recove.retraction_status: Prior claims of zero cutbacks and perfect 1.05 kN peak match were formally retracted in F1720_FORWARD_SOLVER_COMPLETION_FORENSIC_REPORT.md.
item_7_forward_solver_failure_and_recove.pivot_to_recovery_donors: To bypass forward solver instability and coupled UMAT limitations across complex geometries, F1728 transitioned to offline continuum linear-elastic pre-analysis (Method A.1) and later multi-state degraded elasticity recovery (Method A.2 in F1812).
